title: Tight Mistake-Abstention Tradeoffs for Sequential Prediction under Adversarial Injections
abstract: arXiv:2611.28579v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the sequential prediction problem introduced by Goel et al. (2023), where an adversary can inject arbitrarily many corrupted instances in an i.i.d. stream from a clean distribution $\mu$, while the learner is allowed to abstain from making a prediction at no cost if the current instance was indeed injected. When $\mu$ is unknown, Yu and Blanchard (2026) show a polynomial tradeoff between mistakes and false abstentions for classes with finite VC dimension and oblivious adversaries, but still leave open a significant gap between upper and lower bounds in their tradeoff landscape. In this paper, we propose the weighted shattering potential, and based on variants of this potential, provide gap-closing algorithms that essentially characterize the tradeoffs under various settings of interest: When $\mu$ is known, our algorithm improves over Goel et al. (2023) and achieves their conjectured $O(d\log T)$ mistake bound; When $\mu$ is unk

translated_title: 对抗注入下序列预测的错误-弃权紧密权衡
translated_abstract: 我们研究了由 Goel 等人（2023）提出的序列预测问题：对手可以在来自干净分布 μ 的独立同分布数据流中注入任意多的损坏实例，而学习器在当前实例确实被注入时可以无偿地选择弃权、不作预测。当 μ 未知时，Yu 和 Blanchard（2026）证明了在有限 VC 维的类别和遗忘型（oblivious）对手下，错误数与错误弃权之间存在多项式式权衡，但其权衡格局中上下界之间仍存在显著差距。在本文中，我们提出了加权打散势，并基于该势的若干变体，给出了弥合差距的算法，从本质上刻画了多种感兴趣设定下的权衡关系：当 μ 已知时，我们的算法改进了 Goel 等人（2023）的结果，并达到了他们所猜想 O(d log T) 的错误界；当 μ 未……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出“加权打散势”及其变体，为对抗注入下的序列预测问题给出了弥合上下界差距的算法，在不同设定下基本紧致地刻画了错误-弃权权衡，并在分布已知时达到了此前猜想的 O(d log T) 错误界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the weighted shattering potential and its variants, yielding gap-closing algorithms that essentially characterize tight mistake-abstention tradeoffs for sequential prediction under adversarial injections, including achieving the conjectured O(d log T) mistake bound when the distribution is known.
